sections.kicker: Prepared for Azuleo by Atla · November 2026
sections.lead: We looked at your site and your Instagram the way a new customer would. Here is what stood out, in order of weight.
sections.thesis: Azuleo has an editorial world. The captions still talk like any bikini shop.
sections.keep: The caption voice of Ola de Calor: Paso 02, prepárese un refresco y ajústese los breteles. It is funny and nobody else sounds like it.

sections.label: Front door
title: Three things people
meet first.
Three things
people meet
first.

pins.what: The captions say Azuleo's bikinis are the prettiest.
pins.why: Every swimwear label says it. The ownable names are Ola de Calor and the editorials, and they come second.
pins.how: Describe the bikinis in the voice of the editorials.
pins.label: Your captions
pins.cost: Shoppers compare on price, because the only thing they are told is that the bikinis are pretty.

pins.area: Ola de Calor in yellow script over a striped bikini
pins.what: Ola de Calor in yellow script over the striped bikini is the strongest look Azuleo has.
pins.why: A named campaign with a retro script gives Azuleo a look that beachwear brands rarely have.
pins.how: Carry the yellow script and the editorial naming into the rest of the site and the grid.
pins.label: Your site
pins.cost: The campaign look stays on one hero and never reaches the rest.

pins.what: The bio holds the origin. The site's first screen does not repeat it.
pins.why: Made in Argentina is a real reason to choose Azuleo over imported swimwear.
pins.how: Say where the cloth and the sewing happen, in the editorial voice.
pins.label: Your bio
pins.cost: Azuleo reads as bikinis from anywhere.

sections.intro: You asked for a look at Azuleo. I spent some time on your site and your Instagram. Three things stood out.
